What it does: Master switch for every option; the toggle hotkey flips it.
Turns the whole mod on/off in game.
Notification when the hotkey is used.

Reloads never use anything up: the old magazine goes back into your rig/pockets/backpack refilled (also on a double-tap quick reload); with no spare the gun's own magazine is refilled and reloaded. Loose-round guns (tubes, internal magazines, revolvers, break-action, chamber loading, grenade launchers, flare guns) load to full without using rounds, even with none on you. R puts a new rocket in an empty RShG-2.

With Infinite ammo on, the hold-R reload menu lists every magazine that fits and every round type the gun takes. Magazines you do not own are borrowed and returned as soon as they leave the gun (inventory unchanged at raid end). Your pick sticks for later reloads.
Firing never takes a round out of the magazine; an empty gun is refilled and chambered when idle. The RShG-2 gets a new rocket after every shot.
Firing never lowers weapon durability or max durability.
No malfunctions and no overheating.
A thrown grenade is replaced by the same type in the same spot and quick slot; the selected grenade stays selected.
Meds, food, drinks, stims and injectors are never used up.
Keys and keycards never lose a use (incl. the Labs access card).
Buy without paying: traders, flea, fees, repairs, insurance, healing, hideout upgrades and scav case. Paid exfils and BTR services refund in raid. Money is never added or removed.
No damage, bleeding, fractures or death; heals fully when turned on.
Energy and hydration stay full.
Body stamina, arm stamina and breath stay full.
Hits never lower armor, plate or helmet durability; protection is unchanged.
Never overweight: no speed limits, extra drain or inertia from weight.
The raid timer never ends the raid.
An empty turret belt refills right away.
Firing a turret never takes a round from its belt.
Generator fuel, water filters and air filters never run down.
